blocks.text: OLONGAPO CITY — Extensive land conversion and earth-moving activities in Capas, Tarlac, have raised concerns over the potential impact on water sources, agricultural lands and biodiversity as the government prepares an area in New Clark City for a proposed Economic Security Zone (ESZ), environmental advocates said on Sunday. More than 50 environmentalists, scientists, engineers, youth, artists and representatives of sectoral organizations joined a solidarity mission to Ayta and peasant communities in Sitios Manabayukan and Binyayan in Barangay O’Donnell on Saturday to document the reported impacts of preparations for the ESZ, being advanced under the US-backed Pax Silica initiative.
